tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Day is a clear, pale sky; Night is deep navy.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and rows that sit on ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, pressed rows, the track behind a progress line.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and quiet buttons on ground and surface (3:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on ground, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps and sources on ground and surface.

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: The brand blue: the app icon, the splash, the G in the logo, large brand fields. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-go
tokens.usage: Text and the logo on go.

tokens.name: go-soft
tokens.usage: A quiet blue ground: the selected tab, the tile behind Juno, a highlighted row.

tokens.name: go-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text and icons: links, the active tab, section labels. On ground, surface and go-soft.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button. One per screen.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover and press.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action and action-hover.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The brand navy: the cap in the logo, dark brand fields, the logo on light grounds. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: The deepest navy, behind Juno at night.

tokens.name: navy-raise
tokens.usage: Shapes raised off navy.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and the logo on navy, navy-deep and navy-raise.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: The tassel on the cap and Juno's eye. Marks the one thing that matters now: a single dot, chip or card per screen. Never a background for a whole screen.

tokens.name: lamp-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the one card that matters now.

tokens.name: lamp-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons for the thing that matters now, on ground, surface and lamp-soft.

tokens.name: on-lamp
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lamp fill.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Juno's plumage. Illustration only, never UI.

tokens.name: bark-deep
tokens.usage: Juno's wing and rim. Illustration only.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Juno's breast. Illustration only.

tokens.name: settled
tokens.usage: A step that is done, with the word Done or a check. Text and icons on ground, surface and settled-soft.

tokens.name: settled-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind a done chip.

tokens.name: clock
tokens.usage: A legal deadline only, always with the word and the date. Text and icons on ground, surface and clock-soft.

tokens.name: clock-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind a legal-deadline chip.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Something failed, always with words that say what happened. Text and icons on ground, surface and error-soft.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind an error message.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface.

families.display: "Lexend", "Pretendard", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "Schibsted Grotesk", "Pretendard", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif

tokens.usage: Cards and rows.
